clusters.mechanism: Concierge chat routing discards RouteDecision.skipped and throws a generic 'No model available for chat' instead of the origin-exclusion reason when exclusions remove all candidates.
Targets retained across waits (provider slots, admission, preparation) are dispatched without rechecking current origin eligibility after catalog/policy changes.
Panel verifier selection (pickVerifier) chooses a verifier without filtering excluded origins, so the router rejects the single chosen target and fails even though an allowed verifier exists.
Eval resume validates stored switch-chain targets with resolveFor, which ignores origin exclusions, so excluded models are not refused up front and the trial errors later.
Missing test coverage of the RunContext.invoke failure path (NoCapacityError with origin reason); tests only exercise Router.route().
The privateOutput NoCapacityError message joins the raw origins array without deduplication, repeating identical origin-exclusion reasons.
Docs paragraph in EVALS.md has an awkward manual line wrap inconsistent with surrounding wrapping.
checkRosterTargets does not check origin exclusion for pinned review roster finders at startup, so misconfiguration is only discovered at review runtime.
